capabilities: Open a fuzzy-searched suggestion modal for callouts
Aggregate built-in and custom callouts via the Callout Manager API
extras: Known issue: some plugins such as Advanced Slides can prevent the suggestion modal from appearing; the README gives a reload procedure to fix this. Requires installing Callout Manager as a prerequisite dependency.
motivation: The author could never remember all the callout tags and had made several frequently used custom callouts.
problem: Obsidian offers no autocomplete for callout types, so users cannot remember all the tags, especially their own custom ones.

relations.evidence: It is compatible with (and depends on) the excellent Obsidian Callout Manager.
Suggestion Modal for Callouts similar to what you'll find in Obsidian Natural Language Dates

summary: Callout autocomplete plugin that opens a fuzzy-searched suggestion modal for built-in and custom callouts when you type a trigger.
